frequently_asked_questions.question: Why did you build an AI assistant for your portfolio?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: To provide recruiters and visitors with an instant, interactive way to query my background, skills, and metrics without scrolling through a traditional static resume.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Are you open to relocation?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: At the moment, I'm not open yet, as I'm still completing my computer science undergraduate course at Nanyang Technological University.

frequently_asked_questions.question: What would be your biggest strengths and weaknesses?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: My greatest strengths would be that I'm very focused on all of my tasks and I would be able to deliver them on time under tight constraints. My greatest weakness would be that I would accidentally be careless to some aspects, and that I'm striving to learn how to be more precise in the future.

frequently_asked_questions.question: What would you say is your biggest influence in your interest in computers?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: When I was young, I was once intrigued by Sethbling's Minecraft redstone constructions, and I was interested in creating redstone command block contraptions. Another thing was that when I was a kid, I used to be naughty and spoil pieces of hardware, particularly CD-ROMs, because like many kids, I was an insanely curious person!

frequently_asked_questions.question: Where do you see yourself in 5-10 years time?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: In 5 years, I see myself as someone who has a great amount of software engineering experience and is adept in learning and adapting to new pieces of technologies. I would have made numerous side projects that are put in good use and that I would be very proud and happy about myself that I have made the steps to help others in need. In 10 years time, knowing that I have extensive experience in the industry, I see myself ideating a future startup that would help to suit the community better.

frequently_asked_questions.question: What was your story on how you got into IT and computing?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: So when I was in pre-school, I was relatively fascinated with knowing how computers and other technologies work, where I would described myself as being relatively naughty and I would play with the CD drives to learn how it works (which upsets my parents to a certain extent, but as long as they know I don't do that again, it's all good). Also, I would fiddle around with learning how to use computer software programs at a relatively young age, where I learn how to use Cinema 4D by myself without any mentor to teach me. Later on, after my 10th birthday, I started playing Minecraft, and it has become my favourite game of all time as I am instantly fascinated with interacting in an interactive sandbox world filled with cubes. Minecraft has given me a space where it allowed me to learn how to tinker and build things, which eventually shaped me into the developer I am right now!

frequently_asked_questions.question: What made you interested in pursuing Computer Science?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Knowing that I have a strong interest in playing Minecraft since 10 years old, I watched Sethbling - a Minecraft Youtuber (and speedrunner) who is well known for making insane redstone contraption videos. Knowing that he uses Redstone, a Minecraft equivalent of a wire, the way he executes it in the video was just so fascinating and inspiring to me, where I desperately wanted to make my own Redstone contraptions! Knowing that he graduated with a Computer Science degree also made me interested to complete a Computer Science degree too!
